backface_from.doc: filters: a position 'x y z'; drops what faces away from it

base_enable.doc: filters: start from the base group in 'pattern' (empty: everything)

boundary_groups.doc: filters: also make '<name>_boundary', the edge group around what was selected

bounds_partial.doc: filters: include entities that are only partly inside (otherwise all of their points must be)

bounds_type.doc: filters: the region's shape; box_size is its full size (a sphere is the ellipsoid inside it)

combine.doc: How to merge with an existing group of the name (Initial Merge)

direction.doc: Reference normal for Normal/Coplanar. Explicit Planes overrides Direction and Plane Offset when populated.

domain.doc: What the group holds (an edge group is stored like the edge_group node's)

edges_enable.doc: filters: Include by Edges (angle and length apply to edge groups; unshared edges to all)

max_edge_angle.doc: Maximum edge angle in degrees for edge filtering.

max_edge_angle_on.doc: filters: only edges at most this many degrees off flat

max_edge_length.doc: Maximum edge length for edge filtering.

max_edge_length_on.doc: Enable the maximum edge length filter.

method.doc: pattern: groups, ranges or an expression like '@P.z > 1'; bounding_box: inside a box; normal: facing a direction; random: a percentage; boundary: on open edges; filters: Houdini's combinable sections (base group, bounding region, normals, edges, random chance: an element must pass every enabled one)

min_edge_angle.doc: Minimum edge angle in degrees for edge filtering.

min_edge_angle_on.doc: filters: only edges at least this many degrees off flat

min_edge_length.doc: Minimum edge length for edge filtering.

min_edge_length_on.doc: Enable the minimum edge length filter.

name.doc: Group name; wrangles read it as @group_<name>

normals_enable.doc: filters: Keep by Normals (direction and angle above)

normals_opposite.doc: filters: also keep normals matching the opposite direction

pattern.doc: pattern method: group names, ^exclusions, numbers/ranges ('0-9'), or '@P.z > 1'

plane_offset.doc: Coplanar plane distance along the normalized Direction. Used when Planes is empty.

plane_tolerance.doc: Maximum distance from each reference plane in internal length units.

planes.doc: Reference plane normals and offsets: nx ny nz offset; one plane per semicolon.

random_enable.doc: filters: Keep by Random Chance (percent and seed above)

seed_attrib.doc: filters: a point or primitive attribute that seeds each element separately (empty: by element number)

unshared_edges.doc: filters: only edges used by one face (open borders); for points and primitives, those on a border
